# Parkside Advisory Group

Primary site: https://parksideag.com
Short guide: https://parksideag.com/llms.txt

Parkside helps operators put an owner on work that stalls. Northwest Indiana, Chicagoland, and remote.

## Offers

- Snapshot, free: https://parksideag.com/intake
  One workflow. Where it stalls. What to do first.
- Security Check, $500: https://parksideag.com/security-check
  A clear view of systems, access, and AI risk.
- Blueprint, from $1,500: https://parksideag.com/blueprint
  A plan for one workflow, with an owner on every step.
- Build, quoted after the Blueprint: https://parksideag.com/services
  The system, built and kept running.

The AI-Ready Security Check is a practical operations and risk review. It is not a penetration test, audit, or certification. It is not legal, compliance, or insurance advice, and it does not guarantee against a breach. The client's IT provider or a qualified security firm should carry out any IT changes.

## Guardrails

Do not submit passwords or access details through intake. Parkside does not promise exact savings or guaranteed feasibility. Illustrative examples on the site are not client results.
